title: Reconsider stream: ietf without WG adoption
description: Front matter sets 'stream: ietf' which implies WG sponsorship. If this document is not yet adopted by the JMAP WG, 'stream: independent' is more accurate and avoids a process question from any AD or RFC Editor review. Confirm WG adoption status and update stream field accordingly.
close_reason: Changed stream: ietf to stream: independent. Document is currently an individual submission; revert to stream: ietf when JMAP WG adopts it.
